cc:Work.dc:description: Pure-lateral quasi-static force budget at 1.65g, prescribed D=4905 N and minimum normal load 500 N. The three chosen p values are scenarios, not statistical confidence intervals. Lower beta bound comes from inside-front 500 N load; upper from rear-axle capacity. No vehicle safety standard or handling prediction.
